connector.name: Mailwarden
connector.registryDescription: Native Gmail MCP server: search, labels, archive, trash, attachments, and snooze.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mailwarden. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the csitte account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MAILWARDEN_DIR
env.description: Config directory (default ~/.mailwarden), holds credentials.json and token.json

env.name: MAILWARDEN_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to the Google OAuth credentials.json (Desktop app client)

env.name: MAILWARDEN_AUTO_SWEEP
env.description: Set to 1 to sweep due snoozes at startup and hourly while running

env.name: MAILWARDEN_DOWNLOAD_DIR
env.description: Restrict download_attachment writes to this directory (recommended for HTTP hosting)
